name: Codex goal continuation evidence contract
decision: KRN goals should stay compact and phase-oriented, naming the active objective, current task, continuation rules, evidence expectations, and completion boundary instead of becoming a progress ledger or product brain.
falsifier: After compaction or resume, Codex follows a completed historical slice, broad ledger text, or stale pasted objective instead of the current GOAL.md task and evidence boundary.
doesNotProve: This card does not prove that goals are product memory, that every resume will be correct automatically, or that KRN is product-ready.
